head.title: Guided trips, <accent>honest expectations</accent>
head.lede: Small-group nature trips led by naturalists, in the Western Ghats, Central India and the Himalaya. Each trip page has a day-by-day itinerary, a map and the next departure dates.

where.title: Where our trips run
where.body: The Western Ghats Endemics route runs from lowland forest at Thattekad in Kerala, over the shola country above Munnar and Ooty, to tiger country at Bandipur in Karnataka. Select a region on the map to open its trip.
